verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's rules docs say rules can be scoped, ramped and scheduled, and a rule's optional release plan can ramp up automatically over time. Pricing lists "Ramp schedules" as a paid-tier feature. These are first-party claims of time-based releases, but the evidence is only one-line summaries. missing for 10: detailed docs on setting a specific future date/time for a flag change, whether scheduling extends to whole-flag toggles or draft publishes rather than only rules, API/automation support for scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
